title: Restriction compatibility of the constructed open-section comparisons
statement: For $X,F,i$ as in [new-etale-tensor-open-section-iso], let $e_U$ denote the constructed comparison there. For every open inclusion $V\subseteq U$, the tensor-section restriction $\rho$ [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial] satisfies $\rho\circ e_V=e_U\circ F(U\to V)$ in diagrammatic composition order. Equivalently, the square with tensor sections above, ordinary additive sections [def-sc-module-cech-comparison] below, and vertical maps $e_U,e_V$ commutes. No component isomorphism is asserted here: these are the fixed, already constructed maps.
